messages:
samantha.lee: Hey folks — two quick things from my first week: 1) My official start date was 2026-03-01 — when does health insurance actually become active? 2) I bought a standing desk lamp and a monitor arm for my WFH setup before cards arrived. Can I expense these, and if so, where do I upload receipts? cc @ben_hr and payroll.

ben_hr: Congrats again, Samantha! :tada: Health coverage typically becomes active the first of the month after your start date for hires who start at the beginning of a month. Since you started 2026-03-01, your benefits should be active 2026-04-01. I can confirm on our side and file an exception if needed — pinging benefits team.

alex_payroll: For reimbursements: we use Ramp for ad-hoc WFH stipend reimbursements. If you paid out-of-pocket, submit an expense in Ramp and tag it "WFH-Stipend". If you haven't received your Ramp invite, reply here and I'll trigger one. Receipts should be PDF or PNG.

ben_hr: Notes: - Dependent additions: you have a 30-day window from your benefits effective date to enroll dependents (upload doc scans). - If you need retro coverage (exception), we handle case-by-case — DM me the details.

samantha.lee: Thanks! Quick follow-ups: 1) Do I need to fill any extra form to get the stipend reimbursed or is the Ramp submission enough? 2) Is there a cap per-item or a total monthly cap?

alex_payroll: Ramp submission is usually enough. Please add a short note in the expense saying "New hire WFH equipment — pre-card purchase". Policy: WFH stipend is up to $300 one-time for new hires; receipts must be within 60 days of hire. If >$300, submit a justification and we'll review.

onboard-bot: Reminder: New Hire Benefits Checklist — complete by 2026-03-10. Link: https://intranet.redwood.com/newhire/checklist

ben_hr: Also, payroll cutoff: if you need the reimbursement in the next pay cycle, get the Ramp expense in by 2026-03-12 COB. Otherwise it'll be processed next month.

samantha.lee: Got it — ramp invite is pending. Alex, can you send that? Also I'll attach receipts once uploaded. Appreciate the speedy help!

alex_payroll: Sent the Ramp invite just now. If you don't see it in the next 10 min, check spam or DM me and I'll resend. :thumbsup:

ben_hr: I'll follow up with benefits to verify the exact activation timestamp and post back here before EOD.

samantha.lee: Thanks everyone, that's super helpful.
